verdict.rationale: The llms.txt probe returned HTTP 404, so there is no llms.txt index for agents. However, Signifyd's developer docs do serve raw markdown versions of pages (introduction.md returned HTTP 200 with markdown content), which an agent can be pointed at. That gives some agent-consumable documentation, but nothing is explicitly built or labeled for agents. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, explicitly agent-oriented documentation or guidance, evidence that markdown coverage extends beyond the single probed page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
